title: A fragility learnt from an event's damage (invented)
about: An invented survey after an earthquake in an invented town: 500 masonry houses counted in five damage states at five bands of peak ground acceleration, and a fragility held before the event, declared as if from analysis. The plan fits each state's lognormal fragility from the counts, updates the earlier fragility by them with a credible band, and sets what the earlier fragility predicted against what the survey found. Every count, intensity and curve is invented to show the tool and says so.
